description: Source code for the MasqueEncapsulatedClientSession class, implementing QUIC protocol handling, including packet processing, connection management, and capsule handling within the quic namespace.

classes.name: MasqueEncapsulatedClientSession
classes.description: A class implementing a QUIC client session with encapsulation for Masque, handling packet processing, connection lifecycle, and capsule processing.

methods.name: ProcessPacket
methods.description: Processes an incoming UDP packet from the server address.

methods.name: CloseConnection
methods.description: Closes the QUIC connection with a specified error and details.

methods.name: OnConnectionClosed
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the connection is closed, including notifying the masque client session.

methods.name: ProcessIpPacket
methods.description: Parses and processes an encapsulated IP packet, extracting the inner QUIC packet and forwarding it.

methods.name: CloseIpSession
methods.description: Closes the IP session with a specified reason.

methods.name: OnAddressAssignCapsule
methods.description: Handles received AddressAssignCapsule, storing assigned IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.

methods.name: OnAddressRequestCapsule
methods.description: Handles received AddressRequestCapsule, currently ignoring it.

methods.name: OnRouteAdvertisementCapsule
methods.description: Handles received RouteAdvertisementCapsule, currently ignoring it.
